# Jarvis Movie Gap Report

## Added Now

- Voice + text interaction with spoken responses
- Real-time UI state updates and animated orb interface
- App/site/file opening with broad command parsing
- Web search and summary answers
- Topic-based generators:
  - websites
  - portfolios
  - Python projects
  - browser games
- Memory (preferences + interaction history)
- OCR-assisted screen context
- Free local AI mode via Ollama
- One-command startup script: `RUN_JARVIS_OUT_OF_BOX.ps1`

## Not Fully Movie-Level Yet

- Human-level reasoning and error-free autonomy
- Always-on wake word that is robust in noisy environments
- Deep operating-system automation for every app UI reliably
- True computer vision grounding for arbitrary desktop controls
- Full autonomous multi-hour planning with safety guarantees

## Why Not "Literally Everything"

Iron Man JARVIS is fictional and assumes superhuman perception, reasoning, and control. Real desktop systems require:

- explicit permissions and security boundaries
- app-specific APIs/automation hooks
- robust failure handling for every external tool
- large compute budgets for near-human multimodal inference

## Practical Next Milestones

1. Add full-drive indexed file search service
2. Add browser control agent (tabs, forms, workflows)
3. Add multi-agent planner/executor with approval steps
4. Add OCR + CV element detection for click targeting
5. Add long-term memory ranking and task reflection loop
